name: Sandstrider Dunebone Plate
description: A sunbaked plate of dune bone and grit-bronze.
specialEffects: Used in caravan shields, desert wargear, and heat-hard shells.

steps: Refine raw stock for Sandstrider Dunebone Plate under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Sandstrider Refinery protocol before storage.
